basis: Dine Brands publicly established the decline by March 1, 2023. Its consolidated income statement reports Q4 FY2022 total revenue of $207,965,000 against $229,630,000 in Q4 FY2021. The decline was 9.43%, placing revenue $10,183,500 below the $218,148,500 cutoff. The recovered November 2 Q&A resolves the disputed guidance remark: the analyst explicitly asked about implied Q4 EBITDA. No earlier qualifying revenue bound was found. The earliest date remains unverified because the issuer’s historical event listing for the intervening period could not be recovered.

coverage.detail: March 9, 2022 investor-day deck. The financial targets include multiyear growth and capital returns. I found no explicit Q4 FY2022 consolidated revenue ceiling.

August 9 Q2 release. Dine reaffirmed FY2022 guidance, including adjusted EBITDA of $235 million to $250 million. The restaurant sales measures and planned refranchising supplied no Q4 consolidated revenue bound.

August 9 call, independent transcript. Management expressly described its reaffirmed ranges as full-year results. The issuer’s original registration endpoint, https://register.vevent.com/register/BIc88b05e3032041849605213f69a1b860, was inaccessible.

November 2 Q3 release. Dine narrowed FY2022 adjusted EBITDA to $243–248 million and G&A to $185–190 million. It reported nine-month revenue of $701,437,000 and gave no annual or quarterly consolidated revenue range from which to derive a Q4 ceiling.

November 2 call recovered through the operator’s closing remarks. The analyst identified the metric as implied fourth-quarter EBITDA before the CFO discussed G&A and refranchising. A separate Q4 sales question concerned same-store trends. The $233.2 million consolidated revenue figure was a Q3 actual. This independent transcript resolves the wording that the earlier review left open.

Dine scheduled the November 2 call for 9 a.m. Eastern and described the replay as time-limited. Its registration link led to https://register.vevent.com/register/BI3322b395af004f28bef24fae072b59e5, which yielded no accessible recording or official transcript.
December 2 Q4 announcement declared a $0.51 dividend per share. It gave no revenue update.
December 5 Fuzzy’s acquisition announcement. The approximately $230 million sales estimate covered Fuzzy’s full-year 2022 systemwide restaurant sales.
December 5 transaction presentation recovered as Exhibit 99.2. The $80 million figure was the cash purchase price. The deck gave no ceiling for Dine’s Q4 consolidated revenue.
January 4 leadership announcement discussed the Applebee’s presidency and international operations. It gave no Q4 revenue figure.

January ICR conference host check. ICR linked a preliminary presenter list at https://www.meetmax.com/sched/event_85703/__publiclist_cp.html?event_id=85703. That list was inaccessible. The host announcement did not establish a Dine appearance, and I found no official Dine session recording or deck there.

February 6 Form 8-K/A. Indexed SEC text identifies a correction to September 30 leverage from 3.90x to 4.29x. Direct retrieval returned a cache miss. The identified correction concerns Q3 debt leverage.
February 15 issuer scheduling notice recovered from the original wire. Dine announced that it would publish Q4 results before the market opened March 1. The notice gave no preliminary revenue.
February 21 release declared a Q1 FY2023 dividend of $0.51 per share. It gave no Q4 revenue update.

The accessible issuer-hosted event page displayed November 2025 onward. Historical-page attempts at https://investors.dinebrands.com/events-and-presentations/upcoming-events?page=3 and https://investors.dinebrands.com/events-and-presentations/upcoming-events?page=4 were inaccessible. The snapshot request at https://web.archive.org/web/20230228/https://investors.dinebrands.com/events-and-presentations/upcoming-events also yielded no readable archive.
This independent event index lists the November 2 and March 1 earnings calls consecutively. It corroborates the known calls but cannot establish completeness of the issuer’s event archive.

March 1 issuer copy and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both give 207,965 and 229,630 in thousands of dollars in the quarterly total-revenues row. Company restaurant sales fell from $36,582,000 to $9,694,000 following the October refranchising of 69 Applebee’s. The comparison uses each period’s reported consolidated perimeter.

The 10-K confirms the December 13 Fuzzy’s acquisition and Dine’s December 31 reporting convention. FY2022 ended January 1, 2023 and FY2021 ended January 2, 2022. As a secondary arithmetic check, $909,402,000 fiscal-year actual revenue less $701,437,000 nine-month actual revenue equals the directly reported Q4 actual.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s release displays March 1, 2023. Item 2.02 independently confirms Dine issued the Q4 and FY2022 results release that day. The upper bound is the verified quarterly actual. The unresolved date concerns only whether an earlier public communication established the threshold. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/49754/000119312523055127/d446470d8k.htm
